label: Tea (made tea: the dried, manufactured leaf)
note: The item describes the brewed drink; no item was found for the traded dried leaf. Black (Q203415) and green (Q484083) are separate items and are used as a facet where the ledger prints them.

label: Tea seed (for planting)
note: Seed of the plant; not the commodity tea.

label: Goods for packing or making tea (tea lead, solder, shooks, machinery)
note: Named after tea but a different good; kept so a search for "tea" does not sum them in.

label: Coffee, raw (unroasted beans)
note: Species (Coffea arabica Q47685, Coffea liberica Q47718) and the plantation/native distinction are facets. Q153697 "coffee bean" is the broader item.

label: Cinchona (Peruvian) bark
note: The UK statements file it under Drugs as "Bark, Peruvian"; Ceylon from 1921 under "Dyeing materials".

label: Tanning and other barks (not cinchona)
note: Tanners', mangrove (kandal) and "Valeen/Salem" bark share the word only.

label: Cinnamon (bark, quills and chips)
note: Plantation and wild are a grade facet with no item.

label: Cinnamon leaf oil
note: Printed 1881-1900 as "Cinnamon Leaf" in ounces under an Oil heading the OCR lost.

label: Desiccated coconut
note: The item is grated coconut as a food ingredient; desiccated (dried) is the trade product.

label: Coconut poonac (oil cake)
note: Press cake of coconut; gingelly (sesame) poonac is a different good under the same word.

label: Other coconut-palm goods (laths, rafters, leaf quills, husks)

label: Coir fibre
